errors.problem: The symbol 1 is used both as the identity matrix (in 1-J/9, and later in P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=1) and as the all-ones vector (J=1 1^T). Read with one meaning, J would be the identity. The paper has I-J/9 with J the all-one matrix.
m is the dimension of the ambient label space F^{⊗3}, not of the labels, which range from 0 to m. The paper says the ambient space F has dimension m.

errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: P_V-P_U is zero on the orthogonal complement of V∩U^perp (i.e. on U + V^perp), not 'elsewhere'. The paper says 'zero on its orthogonal complement'.

At time 0 the label is left with an unspecified t while times 2 and 5 use t_S and t_T. In the paper the time-0 gate is on the Y bank, so t is the Y triple's indicator (t_T in the page's notation). The page also omits which wires each time touches.
'So' presents the ratios as following from the telescoping sentence. They follow from L=Ich and I/N=3/binom(h,3): L/N=3ch/161700. The values are correct.

Z must be applied only on the 27 coordinates of supp u_a, with the identity elsewhere (the paper's Z_{a,k}); on k columns the scalar is i^{27k}. Read literally, a Z on every coordinate would break the C factors outside the support.
